question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘laziness’ given in the second paragraph.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Laziness ***means the quality of not being willing to work or use any effort (सुस्‍ती).

 
 
• Example: "I don't tolerate laziness in my class".
 
 
 
• ***Industrious ***means characterized by hard work and perseverance (मेहनती).
 
 
• Example: "Anyway, he is very industrious and energetic in his sweeping."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3 which is '*Industrious'*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Indolent ***means not wanting to work; lazy (काम न करनेवाला; आलसी; निष्क्रिय).
 
• ***Inactive ***means slow to move or act (निष्क्रिय).
 
• ***Lethargic ***means Lazy and not trying to put in any effort (सुस्त).
